baselineDisplay.title: Don't Drop It
baselineDisplay.question: Where does Sam put the vase in the end?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 最后萨姆把花瓶放在了哪里？
baselineDisplay.text:
Where does Sam put the vase in the end?

What are you going to do with that vase, Penny?
I'm going to put it on this table, Sam.
Don't do that.
Give it to me.
What are you going to do with it?
I'm going to put it here, in front of the window.
Be careful! Don't drop it!
Don't put it there, Sam.
Put it here, on this shelf.
There we are!
It's a lovely vase.
Those flowers are lovely, too.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
佩妮，你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？
我要把它放在这张桌子上，萨姆。
别那么做。
把它给我。
你打算怎么处理它？
“我要把它放在这里，窗子前面。”
小心！别把它掉下来！
“别放在那儿，萨姆。”
把它放在这儿，这个架子上。
好了，放好了！
这是一个很漂亮的花瓶。
那些花也很漂亮。

notes: 通读12句摆花瓶对话和提问中译；区分初拟桌子、窗前与最终架子的位置，保留小心与别摔两个祈使句同一时间段及译文引号。核对Sam/Penny及花与花瓶的指代，只调整课号空格。
